CLI Desk for Claude Code is an independent, unofficial third-party desktop wrapper around a user-provided Claude Code CLI. It is not an official Anthropic or Claude product.

CLI Desk for Claude Code 是围绕用户自备 Claude Code CLI 的独立、非官方第三方桌面封装，不是 Anthropic 或 Claude 的官方产品。

**Do not include API keys, credentials, personal data, or private logs.**
